notes.subject: denmusow
notes.rationale: בנותיה literally 'her daughters' — cities personified as daughters, kept literal in Bambara

notes.subject: duguw
notes.rationale: חצרים 'enclosed settlements/hamlets' rendered as duguw (villages); no single Bambara word for the enclosed-yard sense

notes.subject: joshua 15:45
notes.rationale: City register of Judah's inheritance — territorial census listing

translation: Ekron (Ekron) ni a denmusow ni a duguw.
